title: Practice 5: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **звании** — зва́ние: title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.); (military) rank. Wiktionary: звать + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **приказа́ние** — order, instruction. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **созна́ние** — consciousness (awareness). Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**сознании** — созна́ние: consciousness (awareness); realization, perception, awareness; (obsolete) confession. Wiktionary: созна́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: внима́ние — attention; ожида́ние — expectation, waiting, pending; зва́ние — title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.); приказа́ние — order, instruction.
**назва́ние** — name, appellation, title. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**названия** — назва́ние: name, appellation, title. Wiktionary: назва́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **тре́бование** — demand, request, claim (act of requesting). Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: He is reasonable in his demands.
exercises.why: **требования** — тре́бование: demand, request, claim (act of requesting). Wiktionary: тре́бовать + -ание.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **собра́ние** — meeting, gathering. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**собрании** — собра́ние: meeting, gathering; assembly; collection, set; collected works. Wiktionary: собра́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
